name: Pension Appartement Strolz
beschreibung: The Gasthof Pension Appartement Strolz is located in the municipality of Bach in the district of Reutte, Tirol. The surroundings are characterized by the Lechtal, which makes the accommodation a starting point for hikes and bike tours. The accommodation offers rooms and apartments with mountain views. In the dining room, regional dishes of Tiroler Küche are served. The amenities include Wi-Fi and parking directly at the house. The atmosphere is simple and rural, which makes the accommodation suitable for nature vacationers and families.
